summary: Late Georgian period townhouse circa 1830, with 3 beds, 2 receptions, and modern kitchen. Large lawned garden. Prime Stanwix location near amenities, schools, and transport links. Characterful family home in sought-after Carlisle area.
description:
A stunning late Georgian period townhouse, circa 1830, nestled in the ever-popular Stanwix area. Boasting an entrance hallway, two reception rooms, and a kitchen, this property offers a perfect blend of historical charm and modern convenience. The three well-proportioned bedrooms, provide ample space for a growing family.

The large lawned rear garden offers a peaceful outdoor oasis. The seller has submitted plans for a partial internal wall removal to create a Kitchen/Dining Area and convert an existing store into a Utility Room, promising even more functional living space.

Situated in Stanwix, with easy access to local amenities, renowned schools, and excellent transport links to the city centre, this property presents a rare opportunity to own a characterful family home in one of Carlisle's most sought-after neighbourhoods. Don't miss out on this fantastic opportunity contact us today to arrange a viewing.

Directions From Carlisle city centre head north over the river Eden into Stanwix. At the traffic lights by the shops turn left onto Etterby Street.

Services Mains gas, electric, water and drains are connected, but neither these services nor any boilers or radiators have been tested. Key Information: • Standard construction. • We understand that broadband and mobile telephone reception are available. For an indication of speeds and supply please see the OFCOM website: • Vehicle parking is on road. • The property is in a conservation area • The property is Grade II listed.
